description: Header file defining the VirtualInput class and related classes for virtual input handling, including key mapping, event dispatching, and IPC integration within the WPEFramework PluginHost namespace.

classes.name: VirtualInput
classes.description: Abstract base class for virtual input devices, managing key mappings, event dispatching, and IPC communication.

classes.name: KeyMap
classes.description: Class managing key code to key mapping, including import/export and modification of key mappings.

classes.name: InputHandler
classes.description: High-level class for initializing and managing input devices, supporting device and virtual modes.

classes.name: IPCUserInput
classes.description: Implementation of VirtualInput that communicates via IPC channels, supporting key, mouse, and touch events.

classes.name: LinuxKeyboardInput
classes.description: Conditional class (platform-specific) for handling Linux keyboard input via /dev/input.

methods.name: RepeatKey
methods.description: Triggers a repeat key event for a given key code.

methods.name: MapChanges
methods.description: Abstract method to handle updates to key mappings.

methods.name: LookupChanges
methods.description: Abstract method to handle updates to lookup tables.

methods.name: Send
methods.description: Abstract method to send key, mouse, or touch data to the input system.

methods.name: Interval
methods.description: Sets the repeat interval parameters for key events.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Opens the input device or IPC channel.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the input device or IPC channel.
